[SWS_FrTrcv_00392] ⌈Whenever FrTrcv_SetTransceiverMode changes the state to
STANDBY, it shall clear error history in transceiver as long as the hardware supports
such a function.
This modification has the same effect as introducing a new API
FrTrcv_ClearErrorHistory() and adding a call of the function in FrSm’s sequence.⌋()
